# WRIA 10 — 2026whiteriverfloat

This tour documents a float of the upper White River between river miles 32 and 46 (PRISM #23-1096P). The float was captured as a Google Street View of the river, and this page collects the 360 degree imagery from it. Select a tour to explore its stops, and use the map to see where each photo was taken along the river.
